text: Bernd Siegmund GmbH is the welding-table company founded by Bernd Siegmund, which is now run by his son, Daniel Siegmund, in the second generation, and describes itself as a family business.
short: Bernd Siegmund GmbH is a family firm founded by Bernd Siegmund and run by his son Daniel Siegmund.

source.name: Siegmund (Bernd Siegmund GmbH) – About us
source.quote: Bernd Siegmund GmbH – World market leader in the field of welding tables Over 35 years ago, Bernd Siegmund founded the company, which is now run by his son, Daniel Siegmund, in the second generation.
